fact: Mauritania is one of the implementing countries of ECOWAS's WARDIP, whose regional project coordination committee held its first meeting on 11 November 2025 in Conakry.
title: La CEDEAO réunit le comité régional de coordination du projet WARDIP
publisher: Communauté Economique des Etats de l’Afrique de l’Ouest (CEDEAO)
